plan.name: Run declared repository checks offline
plan.summary: Extend plumbing.Sandbox.Run with explicit captured repository configuration so the builder's test tool and final factory check run each selected part's declared format, lint, build and test commands in its prepared immutable dependency environment, offline. Use trusted host-side Go orchestration and disposable containers that preserve a part's build outputs between commands, without requiring Python in Go or Node images or mounting the host's Go cache. Select parts from planned files, acceptance files and admitted regressions through the existing ownership rules, preserve argument boundaries and inapplicable reasons, and report command status by part and phase without treating diagnostics as evidence or claiming the individual native acceptance evidence reserved for the next issue. Keep Invariant's existing Go selection and scheduling unchanged, retain the shared check queue and build allowance, and enforce init, 4 GiB, 1,024 processes, the twelve-minute whole-run deadline, one ten-minute test budget and bounded cleanup across all parts, preserving partial results and failing every unsuccessful phase. Update SPEC.md with existing decision citations, the README within 400 lines and docs/factory.md to describe this execution API and its remaining external-plumbing restriction; the merger must record the new execution decision before the next step because this plumbing build cannot write decisions/.

tests.name: TestRepositorySandboxRunsDeclaredChecksOffline
tests.says: Each language runs the captured format, lint, build and test arguments in the selected immutable dependency environment and directory, retaining build output without host caches or an assumed Python runner.

tests.name: TestRepositorySandboxSelectsAllAndOnlyAffectedParts
tests.says: Planned files, acceptance files, admitted regressions, shared inputs and deleted paths select their captured owners; unrelated parts stay idle and invalid ownership fails before execution.

tests.name: TestRepositorySandboxFailsEveryCommandPhase
tests.says: Failure in format, lint, build or test fails the check with the correct part and phase, retains completed work and accounts for commands not reached.

tests.name: TestRepositorySandboxHonorsInapplicableChecks
tests.says: Inapplicable commands are reported with their captured reasons and never executed.

tests.name: TestRepositorySandboxCannotAcceptDiagnosticRecords
tests.says: Command diagnostics cannot forge passes, acceptance evidence, deadlines or result records.

tests.name: TestRepositorySandboxSharesDeadlinesAcrossParts
tests.says: Preparation and commands retain one whole-run deadline, and all selected test suites share one shrinking test allowance without renewal.

tests.name: TestRepositorySandboxCancellationRetainsPartialWork
tests.says: Cancellation and whole-run expiration retain completed and unfinished commands and remove private environments using a bounded uncanceled cleanup context.

tests.name: TestRepositorySandboxPreparationAndCleanupFailuresFailCheck
tests.says: Unusable dependency environments, failed container startup and failed cleanup cannot produce a successful check or erase unfinished work.

tests.name: TestRepositoryCheckContainerRunsWithoutPythonOrHostCache
tests.says: The production container adapter executes literal commands in one disposable prepared container with network disabled, explicit environment, resource limits and cleanup, without requiring Python or mounting a host cache.

tests.name: TestRepositoryCheckContainerFailureAndCancellationRemoveContainer
tests.says: Production container command failure and cancellation preserve diagnostics and force container removal.

tests.name: TestRepositoryBuilderUsesSameChecksForToolAndFinalRun
tests.says: Both queued and standalone configured builders expose the same captured execution to their tool client and fresh final checks, without renewing or bypassing their build allowance.

tests.name: TestRepositorySandboxQueueHoldsSlotThroughCleanup
tests.says: Repository checks obey the shared queue and retain its slot until container cleanup ends.

tests.name: TestRepositoryTestToolUsesConfiguredSandbox
tests.says: The builder's real test tool stages candidate changes and reports the configured repository sandbox's part and phase failures.

usage.summary: Wrote [plan.json](/var/folders/fz/s3p17rl97r30y73d180fjbmc0000gn/T/invariant-plan-3371293109/plan.json) and 13 acceptance tests covering offline execution, ownership, budgets, failures, cleanup, and tool integration. The first plan check passed; `repo/` remains unchanged.
